description: Turns nightly AUTOMATED (scheduled) backups ON or OFF for a MANAGED data service — the toggle that create_backup (a one-off volume snapshot) is NOT. Once enabled, redu's nightly job backs the service up on its own and prunes to the retention window; see them with list_backups and recover with the service's restore. Works for managed Postgres/MySQL/MariaDB/Redis/Qdrant/ClickHouse and can be flipped ANY time after provisioning, not only at create. Requires a card (automated backups are a paid feature; no-card trials cannot enable them). Pass the service type + its numeric id, enabled, and optional retention (days).

enabled.description: true = turn ON nightly AUTOMATED backups for this service; false = turn them off.

id.description: Numeric id of the managed service (from list_databases / list_redis / list_relational_databases / etc.).

retention.description: How many days of nightly backups to keep (optional; keeps the current setting if omitted).

service.description: Which managed data-service type the id belongs to. A managed Postgres from create_database/list_databases is 'postgres'; MySQL/MariaDB from create_relational_database; plus redis/qdrant/clickhouse.

name: set_managed_backups
title: Enable/disable automated backups
